about: MANZZA Industry Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru manufacturer of transformer core laminations. We cut, punch and prepare CRGO and CRNO electrical steel to our customers' drawings: mitre step-lap laminations, E&I laminations and strip laminations. We supply transformer manufacturers across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu.

intro.headline: Transformer core laminations, cut to your drawing in Bengaluru.
intro.lede: Mitre step-lap, E&I and strip laminations in CRGO and CRNO electrical steel, for transformer manufacturers across Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Tamil Nadu.

process.text: Automated CNC cutting to the dimensions and angles on your drawing, with shearing and supporting operations.
Punching and hole processing for holes, slots and E&I profiles.
Mitre laminations prepared in step-lap sequence, so the joint moves along with each layer.
Step-lap processing and core stacking support for mitre-core construction.
